why_this_file_exists_instead_of_an_edit: Two accepted artifacts print different word-event totals - the device inventory says 48, book_strategy/Ezek.md says 49 - and a writer reading both would reasonably think one is wrong. NEITHER IS. They count different predicates, and each states its own. This is the narrowed-predicate discipline (E-18) working as intended, not a defect, so no repair is owed and nothing is edited: the artifacts' cure was accepted at fixed digests and changing them to settle a non-problem would invalidate that review for nothing. The reconciliation lives here and is carried into the writer brief.

48.predicate: (ויהי|היה) דבר יהוה אלי  — the FIRST-PERSON word-event family
48.composition: 41 vayehi-form (incl. the two infixed-date verses MT 12:8 and 24:1) + 7 perfect היה form, sets disjoint
48.verified_by: orchestrator sweep; independently re-derived by ezek_p0_recheck_a1#e1 and ezek_p0_r3_a1#e1

49.predicate: דבר יהוה אל  — ANY form of the word-event phrase, first or third person
49.composition: the 48 above PLUS exactly one verse

the_single_verse_that_separates_them.reading: הָיֹה הָיָה דְבַר יְהוָה אֶל יְחֶזְקֵאל בֶּן בּוּזִי הַכֹּהֵן
the_single_verse_that_separates_them.why_the_first_person_sweep_misses_it: two reasons at once, either sufficient: the verb is an INFINITIVE ABSOLUTE plus perfect (היה היה, 'the word of YHWH came surely'), not ויהי or a bare היה; and the addressee is THIRD PERSON - אל יחזקאל, 'to Ezekiel' - not אלי, 'to me'. It is the book's superscription, spoken about the prophet rather than by him.
the_single_verse_that_separates_them.confirmed: set difference in both directions: broad minus first-person = exactly [Ezek.1.3]; first-person minus broad = empty

the_rule_for_every_downstream_lane: NEVER blend the two. A count without its predicate is not evidence, and 48 vs 49 is the exact case the label rule exists for.
Quote 48 when you mean the prophet's own word-event onsets - which is what a row seam usually rests on.
Quote 49 when you mean every occurrence of the phrase in the book, superscription included.
MT 1:3 is a real word-event occurrence and a real ONSET. It is excluded from 48 by predicate, NOT by judgment, and a row at the book's opening must weigh it.
The strategy's own instruction at §9 stands: word-event 39 and the any-form 49 are never mixed. This file adds that 48 is a third, distinct, equally legitimate denominator.
